description: Trust anchor for the review-chain captures. Each file is what scripts.review_coverage reads for one merged pull request of this repo, recorded with the gh argv that code itself runs. (private path) verifies these checksums BEFORE parsing (pattern follows (private path)).
shape: head_sha: `gh pr view <n> --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid`. api_pages[<endpoint>]: the parsed output of `gh api <endpoint> --paginate --slurp` (a list of pages) for pulls/<n>/files, pulls/<n>/commits, pulls/<n>/reviews, pulls/<n>/comments and issues/<n>/comments. pr_checks: `gh pr checks <n> --json name,bucket,state,description`, whole. pr_diff: `gh api repos/<repo>/pulls/<n> -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.diff'`, whole.
projection: Nothing invented, nothing reordered, no record dropped (same form as (private path)). Each API record keeps only the fields review_coverage and review_control_plane read, plus ids and timestamps, with their values untouched: files filename/previous_filename/status; commits sha, parents[].sha, commit.message; reviews id, user.login, state, commit_id, submitted_at, body; pull comments id, pull_request_review_id, in_reply_to_id, user.login, commit_id, original_commit_id, path, created_at, body; issue comments id, user.login, created_at, body. The projection was applied by a script at capture time, not by hand. Dropped with the unread fields: commit author and committer mailboxes, which scripts.oss_tip_audit refuses in the tracked tree, so no placeholder was substituted anywhere.
omitted: pr5465.json and pr3359.json hold no pr_diff. Those PRs' diffs add decorator lines of the form `+<at-sign><dotted name>`, which scripts.oss_tip_audit reads as a mailbox; a diff cannot be projected without rewriting it, so it was left out instead of edited. The replay answers that argv with a failure, so a run that reaches the diff reads as could not measure, never as a verdict. review-coverage reads the diff only after REVIEW-13 passes, so every state before the second independent review at those heads is fully served.
regenerate: Re-capture with the argv under `shape`, apply `projection`, recompute sha256/bytes. Never hand-edit a payload to make a test pass. All three PRs are merged, so their heads and review history no longer move.
